text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, celecoxib 200 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 441 capsules (33.5 days at 13.2/day). Corvale General holds 524 capsules (27.1 days at 19.3/day). No FDA shortage posting exists and no action is recorded at a registered plant for this product.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show celecoxib is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The rule-based check confirms no FDA shortage posting and no action before a posting at a registered plant.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately four weeks at both sites. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Supply risk is low but monitoring continues.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place routine replenishment orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (ranked option 1) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC (ranked option 2) as a secondary source — requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
3. Buyer to qualify AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. (ranked option 3) as a tertiary source — requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
4. Inventory team to track daily usage at both sites and report if days on hand fall below 21 — requires inventory manager approval.

Not recommended: No emergency purchases, allocation protocols, or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
